overview: Wobble Tower is a physics stacking game using crates released from a swinging crane. Different crate weights and friction affect settlement and overhangs while wind becomes stronger as the tower grows. Careful release timing keeps the tower on a small platform for as long as possible.
rules: Drop the current crate from the crane onto the platform or existing stack.
A crate counts as stacked only when it settles.
Crate density, friction, tipping and gusts affect whether a tower remains standing.
Three dropped/lost crates end the run; wind grows with tower height.
controls: Space/controller A drops the current crate.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
